propositions: Monolithic build-and-test job in gerrit-verify.yaml hand-copies gate and suite commands from test.yml, risking drift and requiring manual sync validation via test_ci_workflow_parity.py.

A reusable workflow_call _build-and-test.yml should decompose into three jobs (lint, pip-audit, test) with parameterized checkout by gerrit-refspec, eliminating duplication and making drift impossible by construction.

test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must both delegate to the shared _build-and-test.yml reusable, with test.yml preserving job-graph parallelism and gerrit-verify.yaml's build-and-test job becoming a single reusable-call that also moves lint/config-check out of the 4×py matrix.

Five safety invariants in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must be preserved and retargeted: gate-signature validation, script-asymmetry detection, and pre-commit SKIP/redundancy checks now scan the reusable; optionality contract and delegation guards replace copy-sync checks.

Validation gates (actionlint, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_workflow_names.py) must pass with the new reusable structure before merge, and the refactored path must be confirmed via post-merge test.yml execution on branch-head.
